title: The Three Garments by Which the Living Spirit Builds
description: When the operative Divine power comes to make the cosmos, he clothes himself in three external vestures — wind (perception), fire (love/will), and water (truth in the natural) — and through them subjects all the works of darkness above and below. He then strips the garments off, scatters their contents for purification, and conveys the refined remainder upward through the Zone to the Upper Place from which he was sent.
